Atia’s Legacy

EXPLORE • DISCOVER • BUILD • BATTLE


Lunacia was once a place where the gods roamed the land, flew through the clouds, and swam the seas. After centuries of war, Lunacia is ripe for rebuilding.

A renaissance awaits.
Explore ancient ruins, mystical forests, and the shadowy depths of the dreamworld where nightmares lurk. Discover new creatures who guard and protect Lunacia’s secrets. Build a home, a town, a community, an army.

Protect Lunacia. Defend Atia’s Legacy. Endless bounty beckons.

What's Axie infinity?

Axie Infinity is a virtual world filled with cute, formidable creatures known as Axies. Axies can be battled, collected, and even used to mine tokens through gameplay. Axie was created to introduce the world to an exciting new technology called blockchain through a nostalgic and charming game. Axie has onboarded millions of people to Blockchain.
